data.title: 守岸人 · 黑海岸潮汐的白色花嫁
data.description: 【黑海岸灯塔庭院·黄昏】守岸人穿着不透的白色长裙婚纱站在灯塔花园，蓝色头纱像潮汐一样落在肩头；她用双手护住一束小小的海滨花，紫色眼睛第一次因“被等待”而露出明显的温柔。
data.action: 灯塔花园双手护住海滨花束，感受到被等待后紫瞳显出温柔
data.lighting: lavender dusk with a warm lighthouse rim
data.promptProse: The Shorekeeper from Wuthering Waves wears an opaque white bridal gown with blue embroidery, a light coastal veil and a small bouquet of sea flowers. She stands in the lighthouse garden with a small bouquet of sea flowers held carefully in both hands. Her layered blue hair moves beneath the veil like a slow tide, and her violet eyes brighten with the newly understood comfort of being expected. lavender dusk with a warm lighthouse rim.
